items.title: Unit 5 · Story
items.prompt: Listen and choose the word.
items.storyText: This is my nut. That is my nut! No, it is my nut. It is a monkey! Yes, it is your nut. Is that your olive? No, it is your olive!
items.why: In “Story 5”, you hear: It is a monkey! The missing word is “monkey”.
items.hint: Listen to this sentence again. Look at the story picture.
items.sourceLabel: Oxford Phonics World 1, Unit 5, p.51 · Titi narration of the supplied textbook text
items.partInstruction: Listen and choose.
